title: Publication record score, and a graph you can pull apart

focus.title: Colour is now a score out of 100, not a binary
focus.ask: Standing is gone. Each account is scored on what it has published — 40 points of RFCs, 20 of adopted drafts, 25 for chairing, 15 for AD/IAB/IESG, the counted terms saturating. Filters for the Datatracker and for RFC counts are above the legend, and nodes drag. Does the formula match how you would weigh a record?

focus.title: Three bugs the graph was hiding
focus.ask: It was rendering 304px narrower than its container and jumping 152px the first time you touched it; hovering moved the whole picture; and dragging latched but never moved anything because sigma stops mousemove propagation on the document. All three are fixed and tested. Does it feel right to handle now?

focus.title: 897 of 1,338 messages come from accounts with no published record
focus.ask: The trend is messages per day stacked by the sender's score band, replacing the standing/new framing you called offensive. Same unit in every band, so the height is the traffic and the composition is who produced it. Is this the comparison you wanted?
